integrity: Equilibrium, Jacobian, discriminant, rate optimization and local nonlinear spectral-gap proof are explicit. Exact-rational computational checks corroborate identities; finite integrations only illustrate transient crossings. Bibliographic uniqueness is not independently certified. No external independent validation was obtained.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic single-community well-mixed adaptive SIS model with linear prevalence-based link breaking and constant creation only; crossing result is for sufficiently small interior initial perturbations and describes decaying transients, not periodic epidemic waves; the optimal spectral rate at a defective repeated eigenvalue allows a polynomial factor; no stochastic or multigroup inference.
title: A turnover-rate phase diagram and recurring prevalence rankings in adaptive SIS dynamics
